name: Sophronia McClain (Simons)
sources: Ancestry.com, Indiana, U.S., Death Certificates, 1899–2017 (George Simons, 1933)
notes: Wife of George A. Simons; she died before him (he was a widower in 1933).

Listed as Sarah J. (17) in 1870, Sarah (27) in 1880 and Sophronia (46) in 1900, when she and George had been married 30 years; so the Sarah of the earlier censuses is Sophronia. Her daughters: Anna B. and Alvaretta (both about 1870), Merta M. (about 1878) and Hallie (about 1891).
